turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Sofia. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So I have a charge I don't recognise, but also I've been meaning to close this account anyway.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let's take those one at a time. Which charge?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sixty dollars from a subscription I thought I cancelled. Actually, maybe I didn't cancel it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can check. It looks like an active subscription billed monthly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hm. Then maybe it's my fault. But I still might close the account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can cancel the subscription today and leave the account open, if that helps you decide.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, do that. I'll think about the rest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Subscription cancelled. The account stays open for now.

labels.notes: Genuinely ambiguous primary intent; customer retracts the dispute mid-call.
